links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM follow-up recommendations by knowledge retrieval method (default, plain-text RAG, flowchart embedding)
links.effect: Radiologist 1 accuracy 42.4% default, 23.7% plain-text RAG, 89.9% flowchart embedding (p<.001); radiologists 2 and 3 showed similar results (91.9% with flowchart embedding).
links.quote: The accuracy of the LLM follow-up recommendations based on default knowledge, plain-text RAG, and flowchart embedding for radiologist 1 was 42.4%, 23.7%, and 89.9% (p < .001), respectively; radiologist 2 was 39.9%, 24.2%, and 91.9% (p < .001); and radiologist 3 was 40.9%, 25.3%, and 91.9% (p < .001).

unlisted_practices: Flowchart embedding via multimodal image-to-text conversion to integrate guideline flowcharts and tables into LLM context
